rrf_no_guard_tip: When checked, node ages whose rate ratio exceeds the threshold are not replaced by the ancestral age (the guard is enabled by default, threshold 20).
ci_fallback_note: No site count given: vS(b)=0, so the intervals reflect only the rate-heterogeneity component (msz236 simulation protocol) and exclude branch-length sampling error.
ci_branch_var_placeholder: Optional: TSV with the header node_id/var (same as the CLI --branch-var)
ci_branch_var_dialog_title: Select the per-branch sampling variance file
